dslRule:
<!id: java.lang.StringBuffer.to.StringBuilder.local>
<!description: Replace StringBuffer with StringBuilder for local variable declarations for performance, as StringBuilder is unsynchronized and faster.>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.lang.StringBuffer($arg) :: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=> new java.lang.StringBuilder($arg)
;;
summary: Replace `new StringBuffer()` with `new StringBuilder()` when the buffer is assigned to a local variable, for performance.
